AnswerRequest.description:
An answer to a discovery question.

Attributes:
    answer: What the user says, in their own words.
    conversation_id: Continue an existing conversation source, if any.
AnswerRequest.title: AnswerRequest

ApplicationRequest.description:
An application to record.

Attributes:
    job_posting_id: The posting applied to.
    cv_id: The CV used; it must target that posting and be final.
    status: Where it stands (default `applied`).
    applied_at: When it was sent; required unless the status is `planned`.

ApplicationView.description:
A recorded application.

Attributes:
    id: The application id.
    job_posting_id: The posting applied to.
    cv_id: The CV used.
    status: Where it stands.
    applied_at: When it was sent, if it was.

ChatRequest.description:
One user message. The text is stored literally, not trimmed.

Attributes:
    conversation_id: An existing conversation to continue; a new one when omitted.
    text: The message, 1 to 20 000 characters, not blank.
ChatRequest.title: ChatRequest

ChatResponse.description:
What the user sees after sending a message.

Attributes:
    conversation_id: The conversation (a `source` id) the message belongs to.
    message_id: The evidence id of the stored message.

ClaimDetail.description:

JobAnalysis.description:
What a job posting states, field by field (FR-18).

Every field is either read from the posting or explicitly empty (`None`, or an

count as empty, and list entries are stripped and de-duplicated.

Attributes:
    title: The job title.
    company: The hiring organization.
    seniority: The seniority level as stated (e.g. "senior", "junior").
    required_skills: Skills the posting requires.
    preferred_skills: Skills the posting lists as nice to have.
    responsibilities: What the role will do.
    technologies: Named tools, languages, frameworks and platforms.
    experience_requirements: Experience asked for (years, domains, degrees).
    keywords: Terms an application should echo, as the posting words them.
    location: Where the job is based.
    working_model: Remote, hybrid or on-site, if stated.
    other_requirements: Anything else required (languages, clearance, travel).

A posting to take in.

ProviderSettings.description:

get.description:
List applications, optionally those that used one CV or went to one posting.

Args:
    db: The knowledge-base engine.
    cv_id: Only applications that used this CV.
    job_posting_id: Only applications to this posting.

Returns:
    The applications.

schema.title: Response Read Applications Api Applications Get

post.description:
Record that a final CV was used for a posting.

Args:
    body: The application.
    db: The knowledge-base engine.

Returns:
    The stored application.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: If the CV does not exist (404).
    HTTPException: 422 if the CV targets another posting, is not final, or the status
        needs a date.

Move an application to a new status.

Args:
    application_id: The application id.
    body: The new status.
    db: The knowledge-base engine.
    response: The response, unused on success.

Returns:
    The updated application.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: If there is no such application (404).
    HTTPException: 422 if the status needs a date the application lacks.

Store a message, extract facts from it, and record them as a pending proposal.

The message is written as provenance before the model runs; a model failure
afterwards leaves the message and no proposal.

Args:
    db: The knowledge-base engine.
    body: The message.
    embedder: Used for similarity, if configured.
    model_factory: Builds the model for this request.

Returns:
    The reply, the pending proposal and anything the agent produced that was dropped.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 for an unknown conversation; 502 if the model fails.

Like `post_message`, but streams the reply as NDJSON (FR-13).

Events, one JSON object per line: `delta` (growth of the reply), `proposal`
(the stored proposal, rejected items and ids), `done`; or `error`, after which
the stream ends. Streaming does not retry an invalid final output: it is an
`error` event (ADR-0014). Size and conversation checks happen before the stream
starts, so they are ordinary 422/404 responses.

Args:
    db: The knowledge-base engine.
    body: The message.
    embedder: Used for similarity, if configured.
    model_factory: Builds the model for this request.

Returns:
    An `application/x-ndjson` stream.

get.description:
Read one CV.

Args:
    cv_id: A CV id.
    db: The knowledge-base engine.

Returns:
    The CV with its claims.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: If there is no such CV (404).

Resolve a claim to the exact stored fact and the evidence behind it.

Args:
    cv_id: A CV id.
    claim_id: A claim id in that CV.
    db: The knowledge-base engine.

Returns:
    The claim, its entity and the source span.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: If the CV, the claim, or its entity or assertion is missing (404).

post.description:
Edit a CV from a chat instruction, producing a new version rather than changing history.

Every operation is checked against the stored facts; one that cannot be supported is refused
with a reason. The new version is validated, and its issues (if any) are returned: a version
with issues is a draft that cannot be finalised or rendered.

Args:
    cv_id: The CV to edit.
    body: The instruction.
    db: The knowledge-base engine.
    model_factory: Builds the model for this request.

Returns:
    The reply, the new version if anything changed, and what was applied or refused.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: If there is no such CV (404).
    HTTPException: 502 if the model fails.

get.description:
Download one rendered file of a CV.

Args:
    cv_id: A CV id.
    kind: `tex`, `pdf` or `txt`.
    db: The knowledge-base engine.

Returns:
    The file.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: If the CV is unknown or has not been rendered (404).
    HTTPException: 409 if the CV no longer validates against the knowledge base.

post.description:
Mark a CV final, only if it validates.

Args:
    cv_id: A CV id.
    db: The knowledge-base engine.
    response: The response, unused on success.

Returns:
    The CV, now final.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 409 listing the issues if validation fails; nothing changes.

get.description:
Read a CV's ancestry, root version first and ending with the CV itself.

Args:
    cv_id: A CV id.
    db: The knowledge-base engine.

Returns:
    The chain of CVs it was derived through.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: If there is no such CV (404).

schema.title: Response Read Lineage Api Cvs  Cv Id  Lineage Get

post.description:
Render a valid CV as LaTeX, PDF and plain text under the configured output directory.

A CV is presented only if it validates; the three files are written together or the call
fails. A LaTeX failure is reported with the log tail, never as a corrupt PDF.

Args:
    cv_id: A CV id.
    db: The knowledge-base engine.
    request: The request, for the configured output directory.

Returns:
    The three file paths.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 409 if the CV does not validate; 502 if LaTeX cannot build it.

Validate a CV against the live knowledge base.

Args:
    cv_id: A CV id.
    db: The knowledge-base engine.

Returns:
    Whether it is valid, and every issue found.

Accept a PDF, DOCX, Markdown or plain-text file and extract its text.

The extension is checked before any byte is parsed; a corrupt file is refused
before anything is stored.

Args:
    db: The knowledge-base engine.
    request: The request, for the configured data directory.
    file: The uploaded file.

Returns:
    The recorded source and the size of the extracted text.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 413 above 20 MiB, 415 for an unsupported format, 422 for a
        corrupt file or one with no text.

Read an uploaded document with the model and record a pending proposal.

Every fact carries the passage that states it; a fact whose passage cannot be
found in the document is dropped. Nothing is written to the knowledge base until
the proposal is reviewed and committed.

Args:
    db: The knowledge-base engine.
    source_id: A document source id from `POST /api/documents`.
    embedder: Used for similarity, if configured.
    model_factory: Builds the model for this request.

Returns:
    The proposal and anything dropped.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 for an unknown document; 502 if the model fails.

Report that the process is serving, and which version is running.

    The liveness payload.

List the stored postings, newest first.

Returns:

post.description:
Fetch a job posting by URL, analyse it, and store it with its requirements.

Taking in a URL that is already stored updates that posting rather than adding another.
Company research runs only when a search provider is configured, and its failure never
fails the request.

Args:
    body: The posting URL.
    response: The response, whose status is 201 for a new posting and 200 for an update.
    db: The knowledge-base engine.
    fetcher: Fetches the page.
    model_factory: Builds the model for this request.
    search: The optional company-research provider.

Returns:
    The stored posting.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 422 if the page cannot be fetched or is refused; 502 if the model
        returns no valid analysis.

get.description:
Read one stored posting.

Args:

    db: The knowledge-base engine.

Returns:
    The posting.

List a posting's CVs, oldest version first.

Args:

Answer a discovery question; the answer becomes a pending proposal, never a write.

Args:

    db: The knowledge-base engine.

    model_factory: Builds the model for this request.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 409 if the requirement raises no discovery question (a `gap` or a

    posting_id: A posting id.
    requirement_id: The requirement the question was about.
    db: The knowledge-base engine.

Returns:

Raises:
    HTTPException: 409 if the requirement raises no discovery question.

post.description:
Turn an interview transcript into one pending proposal (origin `interview`).

Only the user's answers are read as facts. Blank answers are dropped; a transcript with no
substantive answer records nothing and calls no model.

Args:
    posting_id: A posting id.
    body: The answered questions.

post.description:
Apply the accepted and edited operations in one transaction.

New entities, and existing ones whose name or summary just changed, are
indexed for similarity search right after (never inside the write
transaction — D-D). A failed embedding call never fails the commit: the
affected ids come back as `index_pending` instead.

Args:
    db: The engine.
    embedder: What indexes new and changed entities; `None` skips indexing.
    proposal_id: The proposal.

Returns:
    What was written.

Raises:
    NotFoundError: Mapped to 404 if the proposal, or a target an operation
        names, does not exist.
    ProposalNotOpenError: Mapped to 409 if the proposal was already committed.
    OperationsPendingError: Mapped to 409 if any operation is still pending.
    UnsupportedOperationError: Mapped to 422 if an operation cannot be
        applied by this version (`merge_duplicate`, until M1b).
    sqlalchemy.exc.IntegrityError: Mapped to 409; the database rejected a
        row and nothing was written.

Accept, edit or reject one operation; its siblings are untouched.

Args:
    db: The engine. The decision is written through `kb.apply`.
    proposal_id: The proposal the operation must belong to.
    operation_id: The operation.
    body: The decision.

Returns:
    The proposal after the decision.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if the operation is not part of this proposal.
    NotFoundError: Mapped to 404 if the operation does not exist.
    ProposalNotOpenError: Mapped to 409 if the proposal was already committed.
    InvalidEditError: Mapped to 422 if an edit is missing, changes the
        operation type, does not validate, or accompanies accept/reject.
